import math

def F(x):
    # antiderivative of ln(x-1)/(x-2)^2 on x>2
    return -math.log(x-1)/(x-2) + math.log((x-2)/(x-1))

# verify antiderivative by numeric differentiation
for x in [2.1, 2.5, 2.9]:
    h = 1e-6
    d = (F(x+h)-F(x-h))/(2*h)
    f = math.log(x-1)/(x-2)**2
    print("deriv check", x, d, f, abs(d-f) < 1e-5)
